$comment: Held-out evaluation labels (scripts/eval.py). knownPositives come from a code audit by an AI agent (Claude) that read only the project's source at the pinned revision: it did not run Midwrite and did not see its output. findings are classified afterwards, finding by finding, with the Phase 2 classes. No independent human review has been performed; an AI agent checking another AI agent's results is not independent human validation. Corrections go in `corrections` with a reason, never by editing a label to raise a score.

knownPositives.scope: unhandled half-written-state windows in server code; the audit was capped at 30 entries, highest confidence first, so the list is a sample when the project has more

findings.by: AI agent (Claude), finding-by-finding source review, separate from the auditor; did not see knownPositives

knownPositives.consequence: If the activity dies after the provider accepted the message, Temporal retries the activity and sends again; nothing dedups by messageId before sending.
Dedup reads the events written at line 413, so a crash between sending and submitBatch makes the retried activity re-send the whole batch.
Messages are delivered without delivery records; a client retry (random messageId) re-sends to every user.

knownPositives.firstEffect: db().transaction(...) committing status Paused->Running at line 988
knownPositives.consequence: The journey is Running but the restart workflow never starts; a retried upsert sees Running and never restarts re-entry users.

knownPositives.secondEffect: clickhouseClient().insert(...) at line 161, then pruneIndex 171 and backfillIndex 180
knownPositives.consequence: Postgres records the index while ClickHouse is not configured/pruned/backfilled; a retry sees the same type and skips both, leaving the index incomplete.

knownPositives.secondEffect: chCommand(DELETE FROM user_property_index_config) at line 226, then pruneIndex at 232
knownPositives.consequence: The Postgres row is gone while the ClickHouse config keeps indexing; a retry returns early because the row is missing, so it is never cleaned up.

knownPositives.firstEffect: db().transaction(...) bumping the segment version at line 275 (update at 311)
knownPositives.secondEffect: submitBatch(...) ManualSegmentUpdate events per chunk at line 359
knownPositives.consequence: The new version commits before membership events are written, so a failure mid-chunk leaves the segment empty or partial after the capped retries.
The event is stored but event-entry journeys never start; nothing re-triggers them.

knownPositives.secondEffect: triggerEventEntryJourneys(...) per track event at line 143
knownPositives.consequence: Batch events persist while some event-entry journeys never start.

knownPositives.secondEffect: insertProcessedComputedProperties(...) ClickHouse processed marker at line 3746
knownPositives.consequence: A crash before the processed marker makes the retry re-signal and re-run completed journeys that can run multiple times.

knownPositives.firstEffect: chCommand(INSERT INTO user_events_v2 SELECT ... cold storage) at line 96
knownPositives.consequence: Events are restored but cold rows remain; a re-run duplicates events.

knownPositives.secondEffect: chCommand(DELETE FROM user_events_v2 / internal_events) at line 59
knownPositives.consequence: Events are copied but not removed; a re-run duplicates them in cold storage.
The workspace is Active and recomputed while its events are still in cold storage.
The reactivated workspace runs with its history still in cold storage.
The global scheduler skips the workspace while no per-workspace compute workflow exists, so computed properties stop updating.

knownPositives.secondEffect: db().transaction(...) updating the journey node variant type at line 286
knownPositives.consequence: The template's channel changes while the journey node keeps the old channel type.
Uploaded users' traits are written but their manual segment membership is never updated.

findings.notes: segmentsController.ts:440-448 publishes identify events (random messageIds) before updateManualSegmentUsers; no compensation or retry, so traits are ingested but membership is unchanged.
persistFiles (apps/files.ts:18-28,36-72) writes under a deterministic messageId key before submitTrack (apps.ts:65); only an overwritable orphan blob can remain.
Same upload-then-reference pattern: persistFiles (apps.ts:101) uses a messageId-keyed path before submitBatch (:118).
Bootstrap code: terminateComputePropertiesWorkflow is best-effort (lifecycle.ts:130-141) and the later inserts are idempotent upserts, so re-running converges.
bootstrapWorkspace (bootstrap.ts:499-506) seeds demo events behind a flag and startGlobalCron swallows failures: re-runnable bootstrap code.
triggerBroadcast (broadcasts.ts:363-393) uses a deterministic workflowId, tolerates already-started, and the activity sets Triggered itself (performBroadcast.ts:59-62).
processRowsInner (computePropertiesIncremental.ts:3683-3746) is deliberately at-least-once with deterministic per-user workflowIds and versioned updates.
removeFeatures (features.ts:160-190) is called only from the admin CLI; the delete is idempotent and start errors are swallowed, so re-running converges.
journeys.ts:1183-1194 needs status===Running && journey.status===Paused, but journey is the row returned after the transaction set the status (1084-1094, 1141): the branch is unreachable.
recordNodeProcessed runs in a Temporal activity; onConflictDoNothing on a unique index (recordNodeProcessed.ts:50) and a deterministic uuidv5 messageId (:56) make retries converge.
sendMessageWithSender is a retry-aware Temporal activity (activities.ts:270-300) and submitTrack reuses the deterministic messageId (:385); a possible duplicate send is the accepted cost.
storeEmailForViewInBrowser (messaging.ts:998-1014) is explicitly best-effort and writes a messageId-keyed object.
getMultiTenantRequestContext (requestContext.ts:270-345) re-checks and upserts a missing member/account on every request.
appendToManualSegment is a Temporal activity (maximumAttempts 5) with deterministic uuidv5 messageIds (activities.ts:220-223): retries converge.
replaceManualSegment is a retried activity whose version derives from the workflow's fixed now (manualSegmentWorkflow.ts:103-111) and submitBatch uses deterministic messageIds.
Same activity-retry convergence: the transaction at activities.ts:275 is idempotent for a given now and the recompute at :386 is re-run by Temporal.
submitBatch (activities.ts:359) uses deterministic messageIds and enqueueRecompute (:386) runs inside a retried Temporal activity.
updateUserSubscriptions (subscriptionGroups.ts:780-786) writes ClickHouse assignments and the source-of-truth events concurrently without compensation; a recompute can revert the unsubscribe.
deleteUsers (users.ts:1525-1557) runs ClickHouse deletes and two Postgres deletes in Promise.all without a transaction or retry: partly deleted user data.
deleteAllUsers (users.ts:1594-1611): the same Promise.all pattern workspace-wide.

handleOauthCallback (dashboard/src/lib/oauth.ts:258-323) commits tokens and the integration before startHubspotIntegrationWorkflow (its only caller); a failure leaves the integration enabled without a sync workflow.
